name: qb64pe
description: QB64PE (Phoenix Edition) language support for Visual Studio Code with intelligent code completion and 500+ keywords.

program.description: Debug: the QB64PE source file to compile with $DEBUG and debug. Defaults to the active file.

compilerPath.description: Debug: path to the QB64PE compiler. Defaults to the qb64pe.compilerPath setting.

stopOnEntry.description: Debug: stop on the program's first executable line.

port.description: Debug: TCP base port the debugger hosts on (the program connects back to it). Defaults to qb64pe.debug.basePort.

autoAddDebug.description: Debug: if the source lacks $DEBUG, compile a temporary copy with it appended. Defaults to qb64pe.debug.autoAddDebug.

timeoutMs.description: Debug: milliseconds to wait for the program to connect back before giving up.

cacheBuild.description: Debug: reuse the previous build when the source is unchanged (skips recompilation). Defaults to qb64pe.debug.cacheBuild.

maxCompilerProcesses.description: Debug: parallel C++ compiler processes (-f:MaxCompilerProcesses). 0 = auto-detect cores. Helps clean/first builds; a per-edit debug rebuild is one C++ translation unit and can't be parallelized. Defaults to qb64pe.debug.maxCompilerProcesses.

command.description: Run: a terminal command to build & run (used instead of debugging when present, and for Run Without Debugging).

terminalName.description: The name given to the dedicated terminal QB64PE creates for itself. Defaults to qb64pe.

terminalIndex.description: The index of the terminal to send commands to. When -1 or out of range a dedicated terminal is created and used. Terminals are 0-indexed in order of creation, not by visual order. Defaults to -1.

showTerminal.description: Whether or not the terminal a command is sent to is given focus. Defaults to true.

cwd.description: Full path to the directory where the program will run. Defaults to ${fileDirname}

qb64pe.isFormatEnabled.description: Format|Enable: Rewrite keyword casing and operator spacing when formatting (see qb64pe.formatMode). Indentation is controlled separately by qb64pe.isFormatIndentEnabled.

qb64pe.isFormatIndentEnabled.description: Format|Indent: Re-indent blocks (SUB/FUNCTION, IF, FOR, DO, WHILE, SELECT CASE, TYPE, $IF, …) on Format Document / format-on-save. Only changes leading whitespace, never code. Turn off to leave indentation alone. (QB64PE IDE: "Auto Indent lines".)

qb64pe.formatIndentSize.description: Format|Indent spacing: spaces per indent level when formatting. 0 follows the editor's Tab Size / Insert Spaces. (QB64PE IDE: "Indent Spacing".)

qb64pe.formatIndentSubs.description: Format|Indent SUBs and FUNCTIONs: indent the bodies of SUBs and FUNCTIONs. Turn off to keep their bodies at the left margin. (QB64PE IDE: "Indent SUBs and FUNCTIONs".)

qb64pe.formatAlignAssignments.description: Align: line up '=' within consecutive assignment blocks (pads the left-hand side). Used by the 'QB64PE: Align Source' command, not by Format Document.

qb64pe.formatAlignDeclarations.description: Align: line up 'AS' within TYPE/DIM declaration groups. Used by 'QB64PE: Align Source'.

qb64pe.formatAlignCase.description: Align: line up 'CASE "KEY": lhs = rhs' inline assignments (two columns: the ':' and the '='). Used by 'QB64PE: Align Source'.

qb64pe.formatAlignColons.description: Align: line up ':' statement separators within a group. Used by 'QB64PE: Align Source'.

qb64pe.formatAlignComments.description: Align: line up inline ' comments to a shared column. Used by 'QB64PE: Align Source'.

enumDescriptions: Group by SUB/FUNCTION/TYPE block and indent level (whole-block alignment).
Group between blank / pure-comment delimiter lines (section alignment).
qb64pe.formatAlignScope.description: Align: how AS / colon / comment alignment groups lines. Used by 'QB64PE: Align Source'.

qb64pe.formatAlignGap.description: Align: spaces to leave at each alignment column (before '=', 'AS', ':', or the comment). Used by 'QB64PE: Align Source'.

qb64pe.debug.basePort.description: Debug|Port: TCP base port the debugger hosts on; the $DEBUG program connects back to it (matches the QB64PE IDE's BaseTCPPort). The next free port at/above this is used.

qb64pe.debug.autoAddDebug.description: Debug|Auto $DEBUG: when the source lacks the $DEBUG metacommand, compile a temporary copy with it appended (line numbers are preserved). Turn off to require $DEBUG in the source.

qb64pe.debug.timeoutMs.description: Debug|Timeout: milliseconds to wait for the program to connect back to the debugger before giving up.

qb64pe.debug.cacheBuild.description: Debug|Cache build: skip recompiling when the flattened source is unchanged since the last debug run (reuses the executable and variable manifest). Big speed-up for large multi-file projects.

qb64pe.debug.trace.description: Debug|Trace: log the vwatch protocol exchange (commands sent and received) to the Debug Console. Useful while the debugger is stabilizing; turn off for quiet output.

qb64pe.debug.maxCompilerProcesses.description: Debug|Compiler processes: parallel C++ compiler processes (passed as -f:MaxCompilerProcesses). 0 = auto-detect CPU cores. Note: this mainly helps a clean/first build (compiling the QB64PE runtime). A per-edit debug rebuild compiles your program as one monolithic C++ translation unit — a single g++ can't be parallelized — so this won't speed that up; the dominant cost there is $DEBUG instrumenting every line. 1 = single-threaded. Above the core count just oversubscribes (no crash). The cached-build reuse (qb64pe.debug.cacheBuild) is the real speed-up for repeat runs.

qb64pe.debug.decorateConsole.description: Debug|Console decorations: add a run divider, program stats, emoji, and colour to the debugger's milestone lines in the Debug Console (compile, connect, stop, …). Timestamps show either way. Turn off for plain text.

qb64pe.debug.timeFormat.description: Debug|Timestamp format: clock style for the Debug Console milestone timestamps — 12-hour (e.g. 3:41:12.880 PM) or 24-hour (15:41:12.880).

qb64pe.debug.arrayExpandLimit.description: Debug|Array expansion: max elements to show when expanding an array in the VARIABLES view. Arrays with literal DIM bounds within this limit are expandable (e.g. colW(0)..colW(10)); larger, dynamic (REDIM), or multi-dimensional arrays fall back to "Watch name(index)". Set to 0 to disable array expansion.

qb64pe.debug.focusRunDebugViewOnStart.description: Debug|Focus Run and Debug view: reveal (and un-hide) the Run and Debug sidebar view when a QB64PE debug session starts (F5).

qb64pe.debug.focusDebugConsoleOnStart.description: Debug|Focus Debug Console: reveal (and un-hide) the Debug Console panel when a QB64PE debug session starts (F5).

qb64pe.isFormatMetaCommandsMixedCaseEnab.description: Format|Enable: Format meta commands as mixed case.  If isFormatEnabled is false this is also disabled.

qb64pe.isRgbColorEnabled.description: Decorate|Enable: Create the color box in the RGB statement

qb64pe.isOpenOnLineHelpEnabled.description: Enable: Open online help if offline help is not found when pressing F1

qb64pe.isCreateGitIgnoreEnabled.description: Enable: Create a .gitignore if it does not exist

qb64pe.isClickKeywordHelpFileEnabled.description: Enable: Open online help if offline help is not found when CTRL/ALT+Click

qb64pe.isShowLintChannelEnabled.description: Lint|Enable: Show the lint channel when running lint.

qb64pe.isShowLScriptChannelEnabled.description: Lint|Enable: Show the script channel when a script is run.

qb64pe.installPath.description: Path: Full path to the QB64PE directory(folder).

qb64pe.helpPath.description: Path: Full path to the help directory(folder).

qb64pe.compilerPath.description: Path: Full path to the compiler.

qb64pe.isOpenHelpInEditModeEnabled.description: Help|Enable: Open offline help in edit mode.

qb64pe.isIndexDiagnosticsEnabled.description: Diagnostics|Enable: Live linting as you type — report undefined SUB calls and labels, duplicate definitions, never-read locals, and unresolved $INCLUDE files from the symbol index, without compiling. Shown as squiggles and Problems-pane entries. Turn off for compiler-only linting.

qb64pe.isLiveHelpEnabled.description: Help|Enable: Convert hover/keyword help live from the installed QB64PE wiki source (installPath/internal/help) and cache it, instead of the bundled snapshot. Falls back to the bundled help when no install is found.

scripts.install:qb64ref: npm run build:qb64ref && mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/bin" && cp bin/qb64ref.cjs "$HOME/.local/bin/qb64ref" && chmod +x "$HOME/.local/bin/qb64ref" && echo "installed qb64ref to $HOME/.local/bin/qb64ref"
